name: stri_remove_na
title: Remove missing values from a character vector

origin.description: Returns x with missing values removed.
origin.details: Empty strings are kept. Only missing characters are dropped. stri_omit_na is the same function.

translation.description: Returns x with missing values removed.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, or a list of strings and stringi._na.NA.

translation.details: NA is dropped. An empty string is kept. stri_omit_na is this function.
translation.value: A list of the kept strings.
translation.example:
from stringi._na import NA
from stringi.utils import stri_remove_na
print(stri_remove_na(['a', NA, '', 'b']))
